title: Decision to create a VIP-tagged affiliate link inside the VIP sign-up flow has no ticket; WAGR-435 says link association was deferred

transcript_evidence.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: maybe we give them the ability to create it in this workflow as opposed to going to deals, finding the deal, adding the link, / Joyce Kiddell: If you could make it automatically tagged as VIP as they're creating it. / Kobi Kunasekaran: yes. / Joyce Kiddell: Yeah, that makes sense.

what_differs: On 2026-09-30 Joyce and Kobi agreed users can create the affiliate link inside the VIP sign-up flow and that it is tagged VIP automatically. WAGR-432 (VIP entry flow) does not mention link creation, and WAGR-435 states: "How VIP links get formally linked to specific sign-ups/players is still open and was explicitly deferred to a future discovery session".
suggested_action: Add the in-flow link creation (attached to the selected deal, VIP flag set, excluded from CMS via the WAGR-491 mechanism) to WAGR-432 or a new VIP story, and update the deferral note on WAGR-435.
